newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine central bank working on deposit insurance.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine central bank working on deposit insurance.

text.p: Ukraine's central bank chairman Viktor Yushchenko said on Thursday the bank and Finance Ministry had formed a working group to devise a plan to insure money deposited by Ukrainians in commercial banks.
"We have formed a working group on depositary insurance," Yushchenko told a news conference, speaking two days after a bankers' meeting with President Leonid Kuchma.

Yushchenko said that although a growing number of Ukraine's 51 million people were opening bank accounts, the amount deposited had not grown accordingly, leading to a situation where banks could not lower interest rates for borrowers.
Most Ukrainians lost money during the first years following independence in 1991, when inflation reached 10,000 percent, and have been reluctant to put their money in banks.
The chairman added that about five billion hryvnias ($2.7 billion) were in circulation outside the banking system.
